title: I created a 3D lunar rover survey game with Opus 5.
author: oxmannnn

comments.author: CryoNigiri_
comments.body:
The deformable terrain looks like so much fun!

I feel like building a map would be pretty difficult for AI. How did you go about making yours?

replies.author: oxmannnn
replies.body: thanks! you mean map with different kinds of structures, buildings and etc?

replies.author: CryoNigiri_
replies.body: I’ve found that terrain shaping and object placement are still pretty difficult for AI, so I’m curious how you handled those parts.

comments.author: Afraid-Yoghurt6731
comments.body: Looks awesome, but UI is a bit intimidating! Still you can easily turn it into GTA Moon Rover or GTA Mars Explorer, with player getting objectives from different actors on earth and has limited time to accomplish them, competing rovers and maybe some crazy aliens stuff.

replies.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
replies.body: Be respectful. Removed for AI Art or Artist bashing.
